analysis_kind: paired offline token-trace replay; not native chunk backend runtime
retained_reference: unlimited prior snapshots within same session, no eviction, no cross-session sharing; potential upper bound
source_selection: maximum exact token LCP among strictly earlier persisted snapshots; most recent snapshot breaks ties, fixed across chunk sizes
native_reference: reproduce recorded disk lookup/load decision and resident prefix; chunk size alone cannot change source retention
chunk_model: strict complete-chunk storage and full-chunk matching, no partial-tail storage, no dedup or padding
boundary_match_loss: total_granularity_loss - unpersisted_tail_loss; excludes missing storage coverage
storage_accounting: write-instance tokens per snapshot; per-version union of actually skipped prefix token ranges; repeated saves remain separate
bytes: unavailable; no conversion from full-state serialized bytes to chunk KV payload bytes
percentiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; all requests and noninitial same-session requests separately
statistics: per-trace values, n=3 fixture mean/sample SD per workload, paired differences on exactly identical token inputs
scope: no model generation, new policy/controller, backend modification, network emulation or FEMU
